briefing.text: Ocarina of Time's Switch 2 remake launches with a 96, the year's best Metacritic score.
Voters rejected AI data centers in nearly all of 40-plus local ballot measures.
Ramayana: Part 1 opens after more than ₹104 crore in advance sales.
Apple is reported to be cutting its engineers' daily AI budget from $300 to $200.
Claude found Xen flaws that let one virtual machine read and write others' memory.

stories.title: Ocarina of Time remake scores 96 on Metacritic, the best of 2026
stories.summary: Nintendo's Switch 2 remake of Ocarina of Time launches November 5 with a 96 Metascore, the highest-rated game of the year so far.
stories.why: Ocarina of Time is one of the most celebrated games ever made.
stories.happened: Nintendo Life says the score comes from 81 critic reviews and makes it the top-rated Switch 2 game. Forbes notes it is the highest score since Baldur's Gate 3 in 2023. The 1998 original still holds Metacritic's only 99.
stories.next: Watch for launch sales and whether GTA VI challenges it for the year's top score.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The 1998 original is often called the best-reviewed game ever made.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: A 96 from about 80 critics puts it at the top of 2026's rankings.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It lands two weeks before GTA VI takes over the holiday season.

stories.background: Ocarina of Time first came out on the Nintendo 64 in 1998. The Switch 2 is Nintendo's newest console.

meme.top: The remake scored a 96
meme.bottom: the original is still not impressed
meme.take: A 96 is the year's best score, and in this family it still counts as a slight dip.

stories.title: Ramayana: Part 1 opens with over ₹104 crore in advance sales
stories.summary: Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana: Part 1, with Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi and Yash, opens November 5 after one of India's biggest pre-sale runs of the year.
stories.why: It is one of the most expensive and anticipated Indian films in years, based on a central Hindu epic.
stories.happened: Sacnilk figures cited by ETV Bharat show ₹104.58 crore in five-day advance gross, including blocked seats, and 27.69 lakh tickets. Trade estimates put the worldwide opening at ₹150-160 crore. Sony opens it on about 1,300 North American screens.
stories.next: Watch for confirmed opening-day figures in India and its four-day total in North America.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: It stars Ranbir Kapoor and Yash and is directed by Dangal's Nitesh Tiwari.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Variety calls it the widest North American release for an Indian film.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Pre-sales passed 27 lakh tickets before opening day.

stories.background: The Ramayana is an ancient Sanskrit epic about the prince Rama. Nitesh Tiwari directed Dangal.

meme.top: An epic thousands of years old
meme.take: Ramayana's spoilers are ancient, and people still paid ₹104 crore in advance.

stories.title: GTA VI pre-loads open November 10 and the game needs 212GB
stories.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto VI can be pre-loaded from November 10 ahead of its November 19 launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
stories.why: It is the most anticipated game in years and will dominate the holiday season.
stories.happened: Kotaku reports a 212GB install, about a third of a base PS5's storage. Xbox pre-loads start at 7 p.m. ET on November 9, and boxed codes can pre-load from November 12. New Zealand gets it first, on November 18 UTC.
stories.next: Watch for review timing and launch-day server load as release nears.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans have waited more than a decade for a new mainline GTA.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Its 212GB install will fill a big part of many consoles.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It launches right before the holiday shopping season.

stories.background: Rockstar Games makes Grand Theft Auto. GTA V, from 2013, is one of the best-selling games ever.

meme.top: GTA VI needs 212GB
meme.bottom: your other games have been informed
meme.take: GTA VI is two weeks out and already asking the rest of your library to move out.

stories.title: Godzilla Minus Zero is tracking for a $30 million US opening
stories.summary: Toho's sequel to Godzilla Minus One is projected to open around $30 million in North America this weekend, ahead of The Cat in the Hat.
stories.why: Minus One was a surprise global hit and an Oscar winner, so the sequel carries big expectations.
stories.happened: Variety puts it on 3,254 screens, the first Japanese production filmed for IMAX. Minus One opened to $11.4 million. TheWrap says a win would make it only the fourth non-English film to top the US box office.
stories.next: Watch for Friday's numbers and whether it beats The Cat in the Hat for first place.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It faces Warner Bros.' animated The Cat in the Hat on the same weekend.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It is the first Japanese production filmed for IMAX.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Godzilla Minus One won an Oscar for visual effects and built a big US following.

stories.background: Toho is the Japanese studio that created Godzilla in 1954.

meme.top: Godzilla may win the US box office
meme.take: Godzilla may nearly triple its last opening, which is still bad news for the buildings.

stories.title: Voters reject AI data centers in nearly every local ballot measure
stories.summary: Data center opponents won virtually all of more than 40 local ballot measures across 10 US states in Tuesday's elections, early results show.
stories.why: Local resistance could slow the data center buildout that the AI boom depends on.
stories.happened: Route Fifty says Ohio held almost 20 votes and opponents appear to have won them all. Emporia, Kansas banned high-impact data centers with just over 60%. Harwood, North Dakota was the only place backers prevailed. Some votes are advisory.
stories.next: Watch for further local votes in North Dakota and Arkansas next month and responses from AI firms.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: More than 40 measures in 10 states went to voters on the same night.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Data centers' power and water use have become a local political fight.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The votes came as AI companies race to build ever larger campuses.

stories.background: AI data centers are huge computer buildings that use large amounts of electricity and often water for cooling.

meme.top: Over 40 towns voted on data centers
meme.bottom: the one win was in North Dakota
meme.take: Data centers had a rough election night, and they were not even on the ballot as candidates.

stories.title: Apple is reported to be cutting how much its engineers can spend on AI
stories.summary: Bloomberg reports Apple cut its engineers' daily AI spending cap from $300 to $200, with some allowances set to fall to $100.
stories.why: It is a sign that even rich companies are rethinking the cost of heavy AI tool use.
stories.happened: Apple is also said to be weighing a cap as low as $25 a day for staff outside engineering, TechCrunch reports. Earlier this year many firms pushed staff to use as much AI as possible before token bills climbed.
stories.next: Watch for whether other big tech companies set similar limits.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: AI coding tools can run up hundreds of dollars per engineer a day.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Apple is the world's most valuable consumer brand.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Companies are moving from all-out AI use to rationing.

stories.background: Apple makes the iPhone and Mac and has been slower than rivals to roll out its own AI features.

meme.top: Apple gave engineers a $300 AI budget
meme.take: Apple is rationing AI tokens, which is how you know the free snacks are next.

stories.title: Moonshot publishes the open weights for its 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi K3.1 Pro
stories.summary: Moonshot AI released full weights for Kimi K3.1 Pro on Hugging Face, where it topped the trending list.
stories.why: It is among the largest openly available models and is close to top closed models on some coding tests.
stories.happened: The mixture-of-experts model has 104 billion active parameters and a 1-million-token context. Moonshot reports 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, just behind Claude Opus 5.5. It says it removed cyberattack material from training before the release.
stories.next: Watch for independent benchmark results and how other labs answer.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: At 2.8 trillion parameters it is one of the biggest open models released.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Moonshot's own scores put it near Claude Opus 5.5 at agentic coding.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Moonshot says it trimmed the model's hacking skills before release.

stories.background: Moonshot AI is a Beijing-based startup behind the Kimi chatbot and a series of open-weight models.

meme.top: A 2.8-trillion-parameter model
meme.take: Kimi K3.1 Pro is open to all, assuming everyone has a spare data center at home.

stories.title: Qualcomm shares fall as phone chip sales drop 26%
stories.summary: Qualcomm's fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of $10.44 billion slightly missed forecasts, and its stock fell over 6% after hours.
stories.why: Qualcomm's results are a read on the smartphone market as memory costs rise.
stories.happened: Phone chip sales fell 26% to $5.14 billion, while automotive revenue rose 89% to $1.99 billion, SiliconANGLE reports. The CEO said Qualcomm has a supply issue, not a demand issue. Arm beat forecasts but its stock slipped about 2%.
stories.next: Watch for how memory prices affect phone makers' orders into next year.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Its stock fell more than 6% on the results.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Rising memory costs are squeezing smartphone demand.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Car chips are becoming a much bigger part of Qualcomm's business.

stories.background: Qualcomm designs the Snapdragon chips used in many Android phones.

meme.top: Qualcomm's car chips grew 89%
meme.take: Qualcomm is becoming a car company one disappointing phone quarter at a time.

stories.title: Anthropic's IPO filing warns it may be close to self-improving AI
stories.summary: Anthropic's amended S-1 says future models may soon meet its internal threshold for dramatically accelerated, AI-driven research progress.
stories.why: Labs have long debated recursive self-improvement; this is a frontier lab raising it in a legal filing.
stories.happened: Anthropic says no current model has crossed the threshold and it is still assessing the data. It also says it may not spot sharp acceleration until after it happens, and does not expect to let Claude build new frontier models without human supervision.
stories.next: Watch for changes to Anthropic's Responsible Scaling Policy and how other labs respond.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: A frontier lab is flagging self-improving AI as a risk in an IPO filing.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: The filing says using AI to build better AI could pose a considerable safety risk.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It lands weeks before Anthropic's planned stock market listing.

stories.background: Recursive self-improvement means AI speeding up the research that produces better AI. Anthropic makes Claude.

meme.top: Anthropic warned investors
meme.take: This IPO season's strangest risk factor: the product may stop needing the staff.

stories.title: Bethesda finally names The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel in a new teaser
stories.summary: A short Bethesda Game Studios 40th anniversary video ended with the first new Elder Scrolls VI teaser since 2018, confirming the name Sentinel.
stories.why: Elder Scrolls fans have waited more than eight years for any update on the Skyrim follow-up.
stories.happened: Todd Howard presented the video. The teaser shows a scroll buried in sand. Sentinel is a city in Hammerfell, widely believed to be the setting, Kotaku notes. There is still no release date.
stories.next: Watch for a full reveal or a release window from Bethesda.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Skyrim remains one of the best-selling games ever.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The game was first announced at E3 in 2018.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It marks 40 years of Bethesda Game Studios.

stories.background: The Elder Scrolls is Bethesda's fantasy role-playing series. The last main entry, Skyrim, came out in 2011.

meme.top: Elder Scrolls VI has a name now
meme.bottom: the release date is still sand
meme.take: Bethesda shared a name after eight years. At this pace, the date is a 2030s story.

stories.title: Claude finds Xen flaws that let one virtual machine reach the others
stories.summary: Xen advisory XSA-523 credits Anthropic's Claude with finding two bugs that let a malicious guest read and write other VMs' memory.
stories.why: Xen underpins many cloud and security-focused systems, and AI is now finding serious bugs.
stories.happened: The flaws in Xen's grant copy feature affect version 4.6 and later, The Hacker News reports. Patches are out for supported versions, and XCP-ng rates the impact critical. No attacks are known. Another team reported the same issue independently.
stories.next: Watch for patch rollouts from Linux distributions and cloud providers.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: One compromised guest could take over a whole host.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI models are increasingly credited with finding major security bugs.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Every Xen release since 4.6 is affected.

stories.background: Xen is a hypervisor, software that runs many virtual machines on one physical server.

meme.top: Claude was asked to look at Xen
meme.bottom: the VMs now share more than planned
meme.take: An AI found a way for virtual machines to read each other's minds, then reported itself.

stories.title: Google backs the financing for Anthropic's $19 billion Kentucky data center leases
stories.summary: TeraWulf signed credit support deals with Google for debt tied to about $19 billion in Anthropic leases at its Hawesville, Kentucky campus.
stories.why: It shows how big tech balance sheets now underwrite the AI industry's data center boom.
stories.happened: TeraWulf also signed a construction deal with Fluor for three buildings. Phased handovers are expected from late 2027 through mid-2028. Unite.ai reports the leases tie Anthropic to Google-approved TPU chips. TeraWulf shares fell 4%, 24/7 Wall St. says.
stories.next: Watch for the project debt deal and whether Google backs more AI data center leases.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: About $19 billion in leases rests on Google's AA+ credit.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: It links Anthropic's computing plans even more closely to Google.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The campus is planned at about 401 megawatts, Unite.ai reports.

stories.background: TeraWulf began as a bitcoin miner and now builds data centers for AI companies. Google is a major Anthropic investor.

meme.top: Anthropic signed a $19 billion lease
meme.take: Even AI labs need a parent with good credit to get the apartment.

stories.title: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon edges past Claude Opus 5.5 on a key AI leaderboard
stories.summary: Gemini 4 Carbon scored 59 on Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, one point above Claude Opus 5.5, at lower cost per task.
stories.why: Top spot on the main leaderboards keeps changing hands between Google, Anthropic and OpenAI.
stories.happened: Tom's Hardware says it also leads a knowledge and hallucination test with 54, though it trails Opus 5.5 at coding. It costs about $7.76 per index task. Google is first offering it to selected cyber defenders before wider access.
stories.next: Watch for when developers get access and whether rival labs answer with new models.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It moves Google one point ahead of Anthropic on a widely watched index.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Its cost per task is about 23% lower than Opus 5.5's.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Google is holding back a wide release while it tunes cybersecurity guardrails.

stories.background: Gemini is Google's family of AI models. Artificial Analysis is an independent firm that benchmarks them.

meme.top: Google took first place by one point
meme.bottom: and kept the trophy in a locked room
meme.take: Gemini 4 Carbon leads the chart, and mostly cyber defenders are allowed to touch it.

stories.title: Valve warns Steam game approvals are taking up to 12 business days
stories.summary: Valve says a big rise in submissions has slowed Steam store and build reviews, after developers reported missed launch dates.
stories.why: Small studios depend on hitting launch dates, and Steam is the biggest PC store.
stories.happened: Valve usually aims to test builds in three to five days but says reviews now take up to 12 business days, Game Developer reports. Some developers told Kotaku they waited two to three weeks with no word. Valve did not directly blame AI-made games.
stories.next: Watch for whether Valve adds reviewers or changes its rules for new submissions.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: More games launched on Steam by mid-October than in all of 2025.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Late launches can push small studios into money trouble.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Generative AI has made games much faster to produce.

stories.background: Valve runs Steam and checks every game before it can be released on the store.

meme.top: Valve explained the review backlog
meme.take: Steam's review queue is now long enough to count as a game genre.

stories.title: Warner Bros.' animated The Cat in the Hat opens with split reviews
stories.summary: The animated Dr. Seuss film voiced by Bill Hader opens November 6, with early reviews split evenly and a $20-25 million debut forecast.
stories.why: It is the main family film of the weekend and a big bet on reviving a famous book brand.
stories.happened: Forbes counted 10 fresh and 10 rotten reviews on November 3. Variety reports a $92 million budget and about 4,000 venues. Xochitl Gomez, Quinta Brunson and Bowen Yang also voice roles.
stories.next: Watch for its Rotten Tomatoes score settling and its weekend fight with Godzilla Minus Zero.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It opens against Godzilla Minus Zero.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The Dr. Seuss book is a childhood staple for generations.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Warner Bros. spent a reported $92 million on it.

stories.background: The Cat in the Hat is a 1957 Dr. Seuss picture book. A live-action film in 2003 was poorly received.

meme.top: The Cat in the Hat is back
meme.bottom: critics have split down the middle
meme.take: The Cat in the Hat's reviews are exactly half and half, a very Seussian sort of verdict.

stories.title: Anthropic's updated IPO filing shows about $17 billion in third-quarter revenue
stories.summary: An amended S-1 shows Anthropic's Q3 revenue at about $17 billion, up roughly elevenfold, with a $23.3 billion net loss.
stories.why: It is the clearest look yet at the finances of a frontier AI lab weeks before a planned listing.
stories.happened: Nine-month revenue reached $33.24 billion. CNBC says the Q3 loss came mainly from non-cash changes in the value of convertible notes and derivatives. Purchase commitments and leases total about $895.4 billion.
stories.next: Watch for the final IPO price range and how investors react to the commitments.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Quarterly revenue of about $17 billion is reported to be up roughly 1,127% from a year earlier.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Compute commitments and leases add up to almost $900 billion.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The filing lands weeks before a planned November Nasdaq listing.

stories.background: Anthropic is the San Francisco AI company behind the Claude models, founded in 2021.

meme.top: Anthropic made $17 billion
meme.take: Anthropic's quarter shows you can earn $17 billion and still need an accountant to explain it.

stories.title: Meta buys Conductor, an app that runs several AI coding agents at once
stories.summary: Meta has acquired Conductor, a startup whose app runs Claude Code, Codex and Cursor agents in parallel, for undisclosed terms.
stories.why: Big tech is racing to own the tools developers use to manage AI coding agents.
stories.happened: Axios first reported the deal. Conductor says over 100,000 people use it. Its founders join Meta Superintelligence Labs. Sign-ups stopped at once, the cloud service shuts November 20, and the Mac app works until early 2027.
stories.next: Watch for what Meta builds with the team and where Conductor's users move.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Running many coding agents side by side has become a hot developer workflow.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: OpenAI announced a developer tools acquisition the same day.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Meta is spending heavily to catch up in AI.

stories.background: Meta owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp and builds its own AI models.

meme.top: Conductor ran many AI agents at once
meme.take: Meta bought a tool for managing AI agents, then started by managing its users out.

stories.title: First reviews praise Apple's OLED iPad mini ahead of Friday's launch
stories.summary: Reviewers say the $699 iPad mini with an 8.5-inch OLED screen and A20 Pro chip is Apple's best small tablet, though it lacks 120Hz.
stories.why: It goes on sale alongside Apple's first touchscreen Macs, a big week for Apple hardware.
stories.happened: Gizmodo gave it 4 out of 5, citing the 2nm A20 Pro chip and bright OLED display. Downsides include a 60Hz refresh rate and no Magic Keyboard support. Six Colors and MacRumors also published early looks.
stories.next: Watch for launch-day demand when it and the touchscreen Macs go on sale Friday.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Apple's tablets are the market's best sellers.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It launches the same day as Apple's first touchscreen Macs.

stories.background: The iPad mini is Apple's smallest tablet, first released in 2012.

meme.top: Apple's smallest iPad got OLED
meme.bottom: and kept a 60Hz screen for balance
meme.take: The iPad mini now has a gorgeous screen that refreshes at a very relaxed pace.

stories.title: Ubisoft is reported to have bid for Arkane, the studio making Marvel's Blade
stories.summary: Bloomberg reports Ubisoft has submitted a bid for Microsoft's Arkane, the Dishonored studio, as Xbox looks to sell it.
stories.why: It would decide the fate of Marvel's Blade and one of gaming's most respected studios.
stories.happened: Bloomberg reported the bid on November 3. Game Developer says Arkane has several bidders but no deal is close, and a sale to its own management is also possible. Without a buyer, the Lyon studio could face closure.
stories.next: Watch for Microsoft's decision before its December deadline.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Ubisoft is reported to be one of several possible buyers.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: A closure is possible if no buyer is found.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Arkane made Dishonored, Prey and Deathloop.

stories.background: Arkane is a French studio owned by Microsoft through Bethesda. Ubisoft is a French game publisher.

meme.top: Ubisoft wants to buy a studio
meme.take: Ubisoft is restructuring and shopping at once, like moving house mid-renovation.

stories.title: AMD posts a record $13.4 billion quarter and guides to about $17 billion
stories.summary: AMD's third-quarter revenue rose 45% to $13.4 billion, led by a record $8.5 billion from data center chips, up 97%.
stories.why: AMD is Nvidia's main rival in AI chips, and its results show how fast AI spending is still growing.
stories.happened: Non-GAAP earnings were $2.09 a share, up 74%. AMD guided fourth-quarter revenue to about $17 billion, plus or minus 3%. Lisa Su said she expects growth to accelerate further. The stock had fallen nearly 20% in three sessions before the report.
stories.next: Watch for how the stock trades on the guidance and for updates on AMD's AI chip customers.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Fourth-quarter guidance implies about 66% growth from a year earlier.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: AMD is the main challenger to Nvidia in AI accelerators.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It follows a three-day sell-off in chip stocks.

stories.background: AMD designs processors and graphics chips for PCs, game consoles and data centers.

meme.top: AMD had its best quarter ever
meme.bottom: and promised a better one next
meme.take: AMD beat its own forecast and raised the bar, which is how chipmakers say good morning now.

stories.title: Gemini uses paid subscribers' saved chats for training by default
stories.summary: Reports note Gemini trains on saved chats from personal accounts, including paid ones, unless users turn off Keep Activity.
stories.why: Many people assumed paying for an AI service kept their chats out of training.
stories.happened: Turning Keep Activity off stops training on future chats but deletes stored chats after 72 hours. Some chats go to human reviewers and can be kept up to three years. Paid API, Vertex AI and Workspace tiers are exempt, AI Weekly reports.
stories.next: Watch for whether Google changes the default or explains it further.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: A Hacker News thread on the setting drew hundreds of upvotes.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Google warns users not to enter anything they would not want a reviewer to see.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Gemini is one of the most widely used chatbots.

stories.background: Gemini is Google's AI assistant and model family. Rival chatbots also offer settings to opt out of training.

meme.top: You pay for Gemini every month
meme.bottom: and also tutor it for free
meme.take: Gemini Pro subscribers have discovered their plan includes unpaid teaching duties.

stories.title: Amadeus flaw exposed booking data from several Asian airlines
stories.summary: Travel tech firm Amadeus fixed a flaw that allowed access to airline booking data, with Japan Airlines, ANA and Cathay Pacific reporting affected customers.
stories.why: Amadeus runs booking systems for much of the world's airline industry.
stories.happened: Japan Airlines reported about 92,000 affected customers, ANA about 37,800 passengers and Cathay about 53,000 bookings, IBTimes says. Amadeus said there is no evidence payment data was accessed. Korean Air and Asiana also issued alerts.
stories.next: Watch for more airlines confirming whether their passengers were affected.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Several major airlines have reported affected customers.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Exposed names and booking details can be used in phishing messages.

stories.background: Amadeus is a Spanish travel technology company whose systems handle bookings for many airlines and travel agents.

meme.top: Airline booking data was exposed
meme.take: Passengers are advised to treat surprise airline messages with the usual caution.

stories.title: Nvidia is said to require cloud partners to sell mostly to non-Chinese customers
stories.summary: The Financial Times reports Nvidia told cloud customers to sell at least 51% of their services to non-Chinese companies.
stories.why: It would tighten Chinese access to top AI chips through overseas cloud providers.
stories.happened: The reported rule applies to Nvidia's data center cloud partners worldwide, according to the FT's sources. It comes as US limits on chip sales to China remain tight. Nvidia has not publicly detailed the policy.
stories.next: Watch for official comment from Nvidia and reaction from cloud providers in Asia.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Cloud providers with many Chinese clients could lose access to chips.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Chip access is a central front in US-China tech competition.

stories.background: Nvidia makes the graphics processors that power most AI training and is the world's most valuable chipmaker.

meme.top: Nvidia set a new rule for its clients
meme.bottom: the rule is mostly about geography
meme.take: Nvidia now wants cloud companies to check where their customers are before they check out.

stories.title: Noah Kahan announces a 31-date 2027 stadium tour
stories.summary: Noah Kahan's The Last Of The Bugs World Tour will play stadiums across North America, the UK and Europe in 2027, his biggest headline run yet.
stories.why: Kahan has grown from folk-pop breakout to stadium act in a few years.
stories.happened: The tour opens April 24 in Athens, Georgia, and includes four nights at Fenway Park and three at Wembley. General sale starts November 12. His new single, Draw You Out, leads The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping soundtrack.
stories.next: Watch for the presales on November 10 and how fast dates sell out.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Thirty-one stadium dates, including multiple nights in Boston and London.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Some European dates were already listed as sold out.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It lands as his Hunger Games single tops a Spotify debut chart.

stories.background: Noah Kahan is a singer-songwriter from Vermont known for the album Stick Season.

meme.top: Noah Kahan sings about small towns
meme.bottom: now he needs four nights at Fenway
meme.take: Noah Kahan's music is about quiet small towns, and he will need a stadium to sing it.

stories.title: AMD's filing puts its Taalas deal at about $2.9 billion
stories.summary: A securities filing shows AMD will pay about US$2.9 billion in cash and stock for AI chip startup Taalas, with US$1.4 billion contingent.
stories.why: AMD is buying talent and technology to compete with Nvidia in AI chips.
stories.happened: The deal, announced in August, still needs regulatory approval, The Globe and Mail reports. Taalas was founded in 2023 and had raised over US$225 million.
stories.next: Watch for regulatory approval and what AMD does with Taalas's chip designs.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Nearly half the price depends on conditions not yet disclosed.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: AMD is trying to close the gap with Nvidia in AI hardware.

stories.background: AMD is the second-largest maker of AI data center chips after Nvidia.

meme.top: AMD is buying an AI chip startup
meme.take: AMD's Taalas deal is half price and half conditions, which is how most AI deals are now.

stories.title: New game pages on Itch.io have doubled, but sales have not
stories.summary: Itch.io says new game pages per day doubled in two months, without a matching rise in downloads or purchases.
stories.why: Like Steam's backlog, it points to a flood of low-effort, often AI-made games.
stories.happened: Itch.io's chart shows about 3,000 new pages a day in August rising to nearly 8,000 in October. Its No AI filter cuts newest games from about 1.77 million to 432,000. Tagging AI use is not required to publish.
stories.next: Watch for whether Itch.io makes AI disclosure mandatory.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Storefronts are struggling with a wave of AI-generated games.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Daily new pages went from about 3,000 to nearly 8,000.

stories.background: Itch.io is a popular open marketplace for indie and experimental games.

meme.top: Itch.io got twice as many new games
meme.bottom: and exactly the same number of players
meme.take: Itch.io's new games doubled, proving supply can rise without anyone inviting demand.

stories.title: Control Resonant sells over a million copies in three weeks
stories.summary: Remedy says Control Resonant passed one million sales in three weeks, with about half of buyers new to the series.
stories.why: It is Remedy's first self-published game, so its success matters for the studio's future.
stories.happened: Remedy's third-quarter revenue rose 226% to €39.6 million, Game Developer reports. The game still has 2.4 million outstanding wishlists.
stories.next: Watch for further sales updates and Remedy's plans for the series.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Remedy's quarterly revenue more than tripled.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It is the first game Remedy has published itself.

stories.background: Remedy Entertainment is the Finnish studio behind Max Payne, Alan Wake and Control.

meme.top: Half of Control's buyers were new
meme.bottom: the other half were still confused
meme.take: Control Resonant sold a million, and half the buyers skipped the first game entirely.

stories.title: Nothing says its first AI-native product ships in December
stories.summary: Nothing CEO Carl Pei says the company's first AI-native product arrives in December, describing it as a tool with no new screen.
stories.why: Startups keep trying to find a new AI gadget beyond the phone.
stories.happened: Pei said on X the product could not have been an app, TechCrunch reports. He framed it as a productivity tool and seemed to distance it from AI wearables. No firm date has been given.
stories.next: Watch for a reveal and price before the December launch.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Many companies are chasing a dedicated AI device.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Nothing has a loyal following for its design-led phones.

stories.background: Nothing is a London-based consumer tech company that makes phones and earbuds.

meme.top: Nothing announced a new AI device
meme.bottom: they say it has nothing on screen
meme.take: Nothing's new AI gadget has no new screen, so at least the name is finally literal.

stories.title: World of Warcraft: Forever launches with over 1,000 new quests
stories.summary: Blizzard's new take on early Azeroth, World of Warcraft: Forever, left early access and fully launched on PC on November 4 with a level-60 cap.
stories.why: Classic-style WoW servers have drawn huge crowds, and this is Blizzard's biggest new spin on that era.
stories.happened: It adds more than 1,000 new quests, nine new dungeons and a new Skyborne race, dlcompare reports. Players need an active WoW subscription or game time.
stories.next: Watch for server queues and player numbers in launch week.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: It revisits the early years of the 2004 game.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It adds more than 1,000 quests and nine dungeons.

stories.background: World of Warcraft is Blizzard's long-running online role-playing game, launched in 2004.

meme.top: Blizzard rebuilt early Azeroth
meme.bottom: and added 1,000 quests to be sure
meme.take: WoW Forever is back for players who wanted 2004 again, plus a thousand extra chores.

stories.title: Netflix's Matthew Perry documentary debuts at No. 1 with 9.5 million views
stories.summary: The One About Matthew Perry led Netflix's English TV chart for the week to November 1 with 9.5 million views and was still No. 1 in the US on November 3.
stories.why: Perry's life and death drew huge attention, and Friends remains one of TV's most watched shows.
stories.happened: What's on Netflix reports 29 million hours viewed in its first week, ahead of Nobody Wants This season 3. Directed by Mary Robertson, it draws on interviews with Perry's sister and close friends.
stories.next: Watch for its second-week numbers against other celebrity documentaries.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Perry played Chandler Bing on Friends.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Friends still draws new viewers decades later.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Celebrity documentaries keep topping streaming charts.

stories.background: Matthew Perry starred in Friends from 1994 to 2004 and died in 2023 at 54.

meme.top: A documentary about Matthew Perry
meme.take: Netflix's Perry documentary topped the chart, and its plain, careful tone suits it.

stories.title: Tencent fully launches Hy4, a 770-billion-parameter open-weight model
stories.summary: Tencent released its Hy4 model with open weights, a 1-million-token context, and vision and computer-use skills.
stories.why: Chinese tech giants keep releasing large open models that compete with US labs.
stories.happened: The mixture-of-experts model is available across Tencent Cloud and other platforms, ChainCatcher reports via AI Weekly. Tencent is offering a 50% launch discount through December 31.
stories.next: Watch for independent benchmarks and uptake by developers outside China.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: It arrives the same week as Moonshot's even larger Kimi K3.1 Pro weights.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Tencent is one of China's largest tech companies.

stories.background: Tencent owns WeChat and is one of the world's biggest video game companies.

meme.top: Tencent released a 770B model
meme.take: In this week's Chinese open-model releases, 770 billion parameters counts as compact.

stories.title: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil passes $400 million worldwide
stories.summary: Sony's Resident Evil reboot has crossed $400 million worldwide and is reported to reach digital purchase and rental on November 3.
stories.why: A video game horror film reaching this level shows how strong both genres are at the box office.
stories.happened: It passed Cregger's Weapons and Resident Evil: The Final Chapter at $312 million. Dread Central reported a November 3 digital release for purchase and premium rental, which Sony had not confirmed when it was reported.
stories.next: Watch for its first digital sales charts and any sequel news from Sony.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Cregger is coming off the hits Barbarian and Weapons.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Resident Evil is one of gaming's best-known horror series.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Horror has been one of the strongest genres in cinemas this year.

stories.background: Resident Evil began as a Capcom video game in 1996 and became a long-running film series.

meme.top: A zombie film made $400 million
meme.bottom: now it is coming to your sofa
meme.take: Resident Evil is the rare outbreak everyone involved would happily repeat.

stories.title: Red Hat patches a 9.8-rated Linux flaw that an AI model exploited
stories.summary: Red Hat has fixed CVE-2026-98432, a critical Linux kernel TCP bug, while Ubuntu's main fixes are still in testing.
stories.why: The flaw allows remote root access on some servers, and an AI wrote a working exploit for it.
stories.happened: The Hacker News says Anthropic reported in October that an unreleased Claude research model wrote a remote root exploit for servers with an MPTCP listener. The bug dates back to Linux 4.4. Debian, SUSE and Amazon Linux shipped fixes in October.
stories.next: Watch for Ubuntu's general release of the fix and whether attacks appear in the wild.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: It can give attackers root access with no login needed.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: An AI model wrote a working exploit for a critical kernel bug.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Linux runs most of the world's servers.

stories.background: The Linux kernel is the core of the Linux operating system. CVSS scores rate bug severity from 0 to 10.

meme.top: An AI found a way into Linux
meme.take: The month's worst Linux bug was found by an AI, which then did the responsible thing.

stories.title: Nagoshi Studio is dissolved after NetEase cuts its funding
stories.summary: Toshihiro Nagoshi's studio, founded after he left Sega, is listed as dissolved in Japan's government gazette.
stories.why: It casts doubt on Gang of Dragon, a game from the creator of the Yakuza series.
stories.happened: Bloomberg reported in March that NetEase would stop funding it, and the studio was said to need about ¥7 billion more. NetEase has not officially cancelled Gang of Dragon, revealed at The Game Awards in 2025.
stories.next: Watch for any statement from NetEase or Nagoshi on Gang of Dragon.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Nagoshi led Sega's Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio, maker of Yakuza.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: It is another big Chinese-funded studio abroad to close.

stories.background: NetEase is a major Chinese games company that funded several studios in Japan and the West.

meme.top: A studio revealed a game in December
meme.take: Gang of Dragon's development cycle has so far been one trailer and one gazette entry.

stories.title: Meta's first euro bond raises €9 billion from a record order book
stories.summary: Meta priced a €9 billion debut euro bond that drew a record €53 billion in orders, Bloomberg reports.
stories.why: Tech giants are borrowing heavily to pay for AI data centers.
stories.happened: It follows a $15 billion dollar bond the week before. Bloomberg says Meta paid a higher risk premium than Alphabet did on a similar euro deal this week.
stories.next: Watch for more big tech bond sales to fund AI spending.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Investors offered nearly six times the amount Meta raised.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Debt is becoming a main way to fund the AI buildout.

stories.background: Meta owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp and is spending tens of billions a year on AI.

meme.top: Meta asked to borrow €9 billion
meme.take: Meta asked Europe for €9 billion and was offered six times that, a nice problem to have.

stories.title: Phantom Blade Zero sells over 4 million copies in three days
stories.summary: S-GAME says its action game Phantom Blade Zero sold more than 4 million copies in 72 hours after its October 29 launch.
stories.why: It is another sign that big Chinese-made action games can sell worldwide.
stories.happened: The game peaked at over 830,000 concurrent players on Steam. About 90% of nearly 50,000 Steam reviews are positive. It launched on PC and PS5.
stories.next: Watch for updated sales figures and how long it holds its Steam player count.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Four million copies in three days is a top-tier launch.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: It follows Black Myth: Wukong as another big Chinese action game.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Pre-orders reportedly topped Steam's global charts.

stories.background: S-GAME is a Chinese developer. Phantom Blade Zero is its first major console and PC release.

meme.top: Phantom Blade Zero sold 4 million
meme.take: Phantom Blade Zero moved 4 million copies in three days, so the zero was clearly decorative.

stories.title: Lupin Part 4 leads Netflix's non-English chart with 10.8 million views
stories.summary: The French heist series' fourth part topped Netflix's non-English TV list for the week to November 1, with viewing hours up about 71%.
stories.why: Lupin is one of Netflix's most successful non-English shows, and its return pulled older seasons back up.
stories.happened: Part 4 logged 65 million hours in its second week, What's on Netflix reports. Parts 1, 2 and 3 all re-entered the top 10 as viewers caught up.
stories.next: Watch for its third-week figures and any news of a fifth part.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Earlier parts charted again alongside the new one.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It drew 10.8 million views in one week.

stories.background: Lupin stars Omar Sy as a gentleman thief inspired by the Arsène Lupin novels.

meme.top: Lupin returned for a new heist
meme.bottom: and stole back three old seasons
meme.take: Lupin Part 4 is so good at theft it took viewers from its own back catalogue.

stories.title: AI cloud startup Applied Compute raises $350 million at a $3.25 billion valuation
stories.summary: Applied Compute raised $350 million in a round led by Elad Gil, with Nvidia, Shopify Ventures and HubSpot Ventures joining.
stories.why: Investors keep funding newer cloud providers that sell AI computing power.
stories.happened: SiliconANGLE reports the startup has over $100 million in annual recurring revenue and counts Microsoft and DoorDash among its customers.
stories.next: Watch for how it spends the money on chips and capacity.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A $3.25 billion valuation for a young cloud company.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Nvidia joined the round.

stories.background: Elad Gil is a well-known Silicon Valley investor in AI startups.

meme.top: A startup rents out AI computers
meme.take: Selling shovels in a gold rush still works, especially when Nvidia makes the shovels.

stories.title: Prime Video drops The Greatest, a scripted series about Muhammad Ali
stories.summary: Prime Video released all eight episodes of The Greatest, starring Jaalen Best as Muhammad Ali, on November 4.
stories.why: Ali is one of the most famous athletes ever, and biopic series tend to draw big audiences.
stories.happened: TVLine lists it among the day's premieres, alongside Hulu's All's Fair season 2 and Apple TV's Stick season 2. The full season arrived at once.
stories.next: Watch for whether it enters streaming charts in its first week.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Muhammad Ali remains a global icon.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It arrived on a crowded day of streaming premieres.

stories.background: Muhammad Ali was a three-time world heavyweight boxing champion who died in 2016.

meme.top: A series about the greatest boxer
meme.bottom: released all eight rounds at once
meme.take: Prime Video gave The Greatest one release day, like a fight that ends in the first round.

stories.title: Jailer 2 passes ₹800 crore to become the top-grossing Tamil film
stories.summary: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has taken about ₹807 crore worldwide in 18 days, passing his own 2.0 as the biggest Tamil film ever.
stories.why: Rajinikanth is one of India's biggest stars, and records like this are closely followed.
stories.happened: Sacnilk figures cited by The Hollywood Reporter India put its India gross at ₹533.75 crore and overseas at ₹273.50 crore. It crossed ₹800 crore on its third Sunday. PVR INOX and Cinepolis did not screen the Hindi version.
stories.next: Watch for its final total and the date of its streaming release.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Rajinikanth has led Tamil cinema for decades.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It is chasing 2.0, another Rajinikanth film.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: About $81 million worldwide in 16 days.

stories.background: Jailer 2 is the sequel to the 2023 hit Jailer. Tamil cinema is based in Chennai in southern India.

meme.top: Rajinikanth broke a record
meme.take: Jailer 2 beat the biggest Tamil film ever, also a Rajinikanth film, so nobody is upset.
